primary_source.exact_import: In a polynomial-coordinate P2 compactification minimizing the ancestor count, a valuation of augmented label1 and negative determinant cannot lie in Case2. There the first positive label1 determinant c≥0 and the remaining label1 chain has d=(m+1)^2c+m²+m≥0; reaching label≥2 cannot return to1. Hence extraction begins with two FREE centers.
